dedupe_keys.name: geodar georeferenced global dams and reservoirs dataset

description: GeoDAR (Georeferenced global Dams And Reservoirs) georeferences the dams of the ICOLD World Register of Dams so that the register's attributes can be linked to locations. Version 1.0 holds 22,560 dam points georeferenced from the register (accessed March 2019); version 1.1 harmonises them with GRanD v1.3 into 24,783 dams and adds 21,515 reservoir polygons retrieved one-to-one from GRanD, HydroLAKES and the UCLA circa-2015 lake inventory. By-products include a list of 94 GRanD records with suspected location or attribute errors and suggested corrections. A 2023 supplement, GeoDAR-TopoCat, gives each reservoir's drainage topology and catchment boundary. The data were produced by Jida Wang (Kansas State University) and co-authors, described in Earth System Science Data (2022), and are free downloads from Zenodo as shapefiles and CSV under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: coverage is global but follows the ICOLD register, so small dams are under-represented, and the register's own attributes are licensed separately by ICOLD and are not redistributed. Simulation uses: locating dams and reservoirs for hazard exposure and dam-break studies, routing in river-reservoir network models and storage capacity planning. Related records: GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database), the ICOLD World Register of Dams (data-icold-world-register-of-dams) and Global Dam Watch (data-global-dam-watch-database).
